# Peraturan dan Ketentuan Kuis Pemrograman {.pbp-page-title}

Pemrograman Berbasis Platform (CSGE602022) - diselenggarakan oleh Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia, Semester Gasal 2026/2027

**Kontributor:** MUH - Hafiz

***

## 1. Jadwal dan Materi Kuis

Kuis dilaksanakan tiga kali selama semester berlangsung pada hari Rabu, dengan rincian materi berikut:

- **Kuis 1 (Rabu, 23 September 2026):** HTML, CSS, implementasi Django MTV, dan Forms (setara Tugas 1-3).
- **Kuis 2 (Rabu, 7 Oktober 2026):** Session-Based Authentication dan interaktivitas web dengan JavaScript.
- **Kuis 3 (Rabu, 2 Desember 2026):** Dasar-dasar Flutter hingga Flutter Forms, Layouts, dan Navigation.

Lihat [halaman Jadwal](../index.qmd#jadwal-semester) untuk konteks lengkap tiap minggunya.

## 2. Waktu Pelaksanaan

Ujian berdurasi **90 menit** dan dilaksanakan sesuai jadwal kelas hari Rabu:

- **Sesi 1:** 14.00-15.40 WIB (khusus kelas KKI wajib mengikuti sesi ini).
- **Sesi 2:** 16.00-17.40 WIB.

## 3. Ketentuan Pengerjaan dan Perangkat

- Pengerjaan pemrograman dilakukan langsung menggunakan VS Code dan dikumpulkan melalui Scele.
- Kuis wajib dikerjakan di laboratorium komputer menggunakan fasilitas komputer lab dan aplikasi Safe Exam Browser (tidak diperkenankan menggunakan laptop pribadi).

## 4. Prosedur Sebelum Ujian

- Peserta wajib hadir di ruangan dan duduk di kursi masing-masing paling lambat **10 menit** sebelum ujian dimulai (denah duduk akan dibagikan menjelang ujian).
- Semua alat elektronik (ponsel, smartwatch, atau smart-tools lain) wajib dimatikan atau diatur ke mode hening (silent), dimasukkan ke dalam tas, dan diletakkan di depan ruangan ujian.

## 5. Akses yang Diizinkan Selama Kuis

Selama kuis berlangsung, peserta hanya diperbolehkan mengakses:

- VS Code
- Slide perkuliahan di Scele
- Dokumentasi resmi [Django Documentation](https://docs.djangoproject.com/)
- Browser untuk mengakses `localhost:8000`
- [W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/)

## 6. Kejujuran Akademik dan Sanksi

Mahasiswa dilarang keras melakukan segala bentuk kecurangan demi menjaga keadilan, kejujuran, dan rasa tanggung jawab. Tindakan yang termasuk kecurangan antara lain:

- Menyontek atau bekerja sama dengan peserta lain maupun asisten dosen.
- Membuka atau membawa catatan/buku dalam bentuk apa pun.
- Mengubah konfigurasi environment ujian.
- Mengakses aplikasi/tools/bahan belajar lain selain yang disebutkan di poin 5.

::: {.callout-important}
Mahasiswa yang terbukti melakukan kecurangan akan dikenakan sanksi tegas sesuai peraturan yang berlaku di fakultas.
:::

# Programming Quiz Rules and Regulations {.pbp-page-title}

Platform-Based Programming (CSGE602022) - organized by the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia, Odd Semester 2026/2027

**Contributor:** MUH - Hafiz

***

## 1. Quiz Schedule and Material

The quiz is held three times over the semester, on Wednesdays, covering the following material:

- **Quiz 1 (Wednesday, September 23, 2026):** HTML, CSS, Django MTV implementation, and Forms (equivalent to Assignments 1-3).
- **Quiz 2 (Wednesday, October 7, 2026):** Session-Based Authentication and web interactivity with JavaScript.
- **Quiz 3 (Wednesday, December 2, 2026):** Flutter fundamentals through Flutter Forms, Layouts, and Navigation.

See the [Schedule page](../index.qmd#semester-schedule) for full context on each week.

## 2. Timing

The exam lasts **90 minutes** and is held according to the Wednesday class schedule:

- **Session 1:** 14:00-15:40 WIB (KKI classes are required to take this session).
- **Session 2:** 16:00-17:40 WIB.

## 3. Working Conditions and Devices

- Programming is done directly in VS Code and submitted through Scele.
- The quiz must be done in the computer lab, using the lab's computers and the Safe Exam Browser application (personal laptops are not allowed).

## 4. Pre-Exam Procedure

- Participants must be in the room and seated at their assigned seat at least **10 minutes** before the exam starts (a seating chart will be shared closer to the exam).
- All electronic devices (phones, smartwatches, or other smart tools) must be turned off or set to silent mode, placed in a bag, and left at the front of the exam room.

## 5. Permitted Access During the Quiz

During the quiz, participants may only access:

- VS Code
- Course slides on Scele
- The official [Django Documentation](https://docs.djangoproject.com/)
- A browser to access `localhost:8000`
- [W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/)

## 6. Academic Integrity and Sanctions

Students are strictly prohibited from any form of cheating, in order to uphold fairness, honesty, and responsibility. Actions considered cheating include:

- Cheating or collaborating with other participants or teaching assistants.
- Opening or bringing any form of notes/books.
- Modifying the exam environment's configuration.
- Accessing any application/tool/learning material other than those listed in section 5.

::: {.callout-important}
Students found to have cheated will be subject to strict sanctions in accordance with the faculty's applicable regulations.
:::
